trend_reclaim.name: H4 trend / H1 EMA20 reclaim
trend_reclaim.buy: Completed H4 EMA50>EMA200, H4 close>EMA50, EMA50>its value 5 H4 bars ago; prior H1 close<=prior EMA20, last bullish H1 close>EMA20 and H1 EMA50, last Wilder RSI14 between 50 and 65 inclusive.
trend_reclaim.sell: Reverse H4 bearish conditions; prior H1 close>=prior EMA20, last bearish H1 close<EMA20 and H1 EMA50, last RSI14 between 35 and 50 inclusive.

trend_sweep.name: H4 trend / H1 failed range break
trend_sweep.buy: Same completed H4 uptrend; last H1 low strictly below the lowest low of the prior 20 H1 bars, then bullish close strictly above that prior low.
trend_sweep.sell: Same completed H4 downtrend; last H1 high strictly above the highest high of the prior 20 H1 bars, then bearish close strictly below that prior high.

range_reentry.name: Low-trend H4 / H1 band reentry
range_reentry.regime: Completed H4 abs(EMA50-EMA200)<=2*H4 Wilder ATR14 and abs(EMA50-EMA50 five bars ago)<=0.5*H4 ATR14.
range_reentry.bands: Mean of the prior 20 completed H1 closes +/-2 population standard deviations; excludes the signal candle.
range_reentry.buy: Regime true, last H1 low<lower band, bullish close>=lower band and <prior mean, Wilder RSI14<=45.
range_reentry.sell: Regime true, last H1 high>upper band, bearish close<=upper band and >prior mean, Wilder RSI14>=55.

indicators.window: Exactly the last 3000 completed H1 rows (or available prefix, at least 2400 rows and 600 completed H4 bars). H4 grid anchored in UTC; partial H4 bars excluded.
indicators.ema: Recursive EMA seeded from first observed close, adjust=False; span20/50 H1 and span50/200 H4. Trend slope is five completed H4 bars.
indicators.atr: Wilder14 with arithmetic first-14-TR seed then alpha1/14 recurrence; first TR is high-low.
indicators.rsi: Wilder14: arithmetic seed of first14 close differences, smoothed gains/losses with alpha1/14; flat50, all-up100, all-down0.

filters: Weekdays 08:00<=decision hour<14:00 Europe/London, last six H1 bars consecutive, enter only next consecutive H1 open. Reject conflicting directions. Prior completed spread>0 and <=2pips, spread plus both slippage reserves <=10% of stop distance.
sizing: Initial USD500 per configuration and phase; recalculate 1% ceiling from flat balance, budget floored cents, fixed structural stop from last5 H1 lows/highs with 0.1ATR buffer and chosen ATR floor, short spread allowance. Lots rounded down .01 with .10 cap; unaffordable minimum skipped.100:1 illustrative margin check. TP solved from reserved stop loss and cost allowance.
holding: SL/TP only, no trailing/breakeven/partial exits, no time exit, no end-of-data liquidation. One position at a time. Open equity and balance separate. No daily-loss cap silently added.
warning: Historical targets are not a future win-rate guarantee. No live strategy/policy/authority changed.
